root: Two squares symbolize New Heaven and New Earth; nested architecture symbolizes New Jerusalem; seven stages trace light on church. No fixed theological assignment.

sequence.name: Living Water
sequence.why: 外方與內方套嵌成為水流的兩側與天井；原有分流刻線不重畫。
sequence.use: 只在外圍或開紅海構圖兩側；中央建築、經文及禮拜文字不被紋理侵入。
sequence.pos: 外方四周；天井絕對留白
sequence.edge: 取外方與天井的共軸邊，形成短線和入口定位
sequence.type: 重字標立於外方；細字及日程落在清晰天井
sequence.crop: 白模完整保留；不切十字架、屋頂或天井

sequence.name: The Journal
sequence.why: 橫向雙方成為編輯雙頁；紙地本身就是留白，版線來自兩個底邊及中縫。
sequence.use: 不做全刊固定底紋；依內容選圖，局部印刷線只服務分欄、引文或頁碼。
sequence.weight: 分欄細線為原方邊；不另加裝飾星野
sequence.pos: 兩方下緣及中縫（不是底紋）
sequence.edge: 兩段50單位線與4單位方間距，導出雙頁節拍
sequence.type: 英文刊頭與中文副題沿同一橫軸，信章保持獨立
sequence.crop: 兩張主圖各使用方形窗口，必要時保留原畫幅

sequence.name: Emmaus
sequence.why: 由原方的邊折返，兩族刻線以共同方窗分隔；這是交織的材質裁切，並非再次描畫完整交織小章。
sequence.use: 刻線以兩側書頁的外緣進入，正文及共同方窗保留純紙；不是滿版經緯網。
sequence.weight: 近折角粗、遠端細；兩組線重不同但原方等大
sequence.pos: 左上、右下交織場；中央32×32方窗空白
sequence.edge: 交點前後順序決定線段中斷；返回原閱讀位置不加箭頭
sequence.type: 書卷與章次沿原方邊；中英經文印面正立
sequence.crop: 圖版與地圖佔另一方；重要地名不裁切

sequence.name: Olive Mountain
sequence.why: 縱向上下雙方形成高差與山勢；保留原有連續等高線的相位，非兩張重複貼圖。
sequence.use: 上下連續裁切，人物與講道經文有清晰安全區；不改已確認的卡背或P2地形。
sequence.pos: 縱向兩場同一底圖；中縫不填墨
sequence.edge: 上下方邊形成垂直閱讀節奏與欄目節拍
sequence.type: 講員名稱、題名與經文沿縱軸；不壓人物
sequence.crop: 人像面部不裁切；地形連續而非卡片重置

sequence.name: Dawn Books
sequence.why: 由前後等大原方的對應邊產生上折面、側折面；刻線像書頁的層疊，不另畫無關花紋。
sequence.use: 只在書脊、上沿、側沿及版芯外緣；正視方留給完整書封、同冊圖版、經文。
sequence.weight: 折邊主線與內頁細線同向；層間不等密
sequence.pos: 上與右兩個派生面；正面留空
sequence.edge: 由折角生成版芯細線、書脊及目錄分段
sequence.type: 書名與作者維持正立，折面只決定錨點
sequence.crop: 書封原比例 contain，不切文字

sequence.coverageDefinition: geometric area budget in square proof, not actual ink pixel coverage or production limit

rules.typography: existing OS fonts and roles remain authority; locate by original square edges, negative field and reading hierarchy; never geometrically distort glyphs
rules.layout: two actual square scripture impressions dominate; use anchors rather than enlarged small seal
rules.image: derive framing from square and fold coordinates but preserve semantic content, original artwork and aspect ratio when needed
rules.navigation: selective existing crest for destination; return label and retained reading state; no invented decorative arrows; retain necessary functional controls
rules.line: every rule has parent geometric edge, reading role, width and length; no ornamental untraceable stroke
rules.texture: derive support, edge, direction, intensity and coverage from growth line; preserve protected masters and no mandatory Journal pattern
rules.approval: candidate only; user approval before changing OS or production

contextProof.candidate: opt-in texture layers only on 03/05/06/07, existing content, layout and seals preserved
